story.title: The Acorn Transit Map of Central Park
story.question: How can the lost squirrel deliver the final delivery note across the crowded city railway without dropping it?
story.answer: By rolling the note inside an empty hazelnut shell through the railway tracks.

story_beats.headline: Missing Mail Mystery
story_beats.speech: Look closely at the railway platform schedule because our final mail delivery note is missing from the slot.
story_beats.label: Beat One
story_beats.visual_prompt: A brown squirrel stands alert on a wooden railway platform in a busy city railway station, sniffing a small paper note next to a single dropped coin.

story_beats.headline: Rolling the Message
story_beats.speech: We must curl this important paper tightly and tuck it securely inside an empty hazelnut shell for safe transit.
story_beats.label: Beat Two
story_beats.visual_prompt: A tiny grey mouse pushes a hollow hazelnut shell across the dusty floor of a city railway station near a metal track rail.

story_beats.headline: Navigating the Rails
story_beats.speech: Push the shell gently past the iron rail when the rumbling train engine passes by overhead.
story_beats.label: Beat Three
story_beats.visual_prompt: A brown squirrel uses its paw to nudge a rolling hazelnut shell between wooden ties on a city railway track during daytime.

story_beats.headline: Successful Delivery
story_beats.speech: The shell has reached the terminal mailbox successfully, proving that teamwork beats any complex transit puzzle.
story_beats.label: Beat Four
story_beats.visual_prompt: A tiny grey mouse sits happily inside a metal mail slot at a city railway terminal beside a split hazelnut shell.

story.central_conflict: A misplaced mail note must traverse active railway lines before sunset.
story.decisive_choice: The squirrel places the note into a rolling shell instead of carrying it by hand.
story.resolution: The note rolls safely into the destination station right on schedule.

characters.mouse: A small grey mouse with rounded ears and bright observant eyes, featuring completely natural animal anatomy without clothes.

objects.shell: An empty brown hazelnut shell split cleanly in half.

story.title: The Grand Urban Transit Puzzle
story.question: How can the lost transit tokens be restored to the underground terminal?
story.answer: By rolling polished acorns along the grooves of the old paving stones.

story_beats.headline: The Missing Tokens
story_beats.speech: Look closely at the railway terminal map because every single transit token has completely vanished from the wooden box.
story_beats.label: Missing Tokens
story_beats.visual_prompt: A brown squirrel with a bushy tail stands inside a weathered railway station looking at an empty wooden box on the platform.

story_beats.headline: Tracing the Tracks
story_beats.speech: We must follow these tiny paw prints across the city pavement right up to the edge of the deep drainage grate.
story_beats.label: Paw Prints
story_beats.visual_prompt: A small grey mouse with long whiskers sniffs at tiny mud footprints on a cobblestone city street near a metal drainage grate.

story_beats.headline: The Rolling Mechanism
story_beats.speech: Roll this heavy round pebble down the paved groove so it triggers the hidden lever beneath the street level.
story_beats.label: Paved Groove
story_beats.visual_prompt: A brown squirrel with a bushy tail pushes a smooth round pebble along a carved stone groove on a sunny city sidewalk.

story_beats.headline: Tokens Restored
story_beats.speech: The sliding stone mechanism successfully guides every missing token back into the terminal box for the morning rush.
story_beats.label: Terminal Box
story_beats.visual_prompt: A small grey mouse with long whiskers sits beside a filled wooden box inside the bustling railway station terminal.

story.central_conflict: Misplaced transit tokens blocking the underground terminal routes.
story.decisive_choice: Pushing the largest acorn through the drainage grate shortcut.
story.resolution: All tokens slide securely into place, reopening the municipal transit lines.

story.title: The Autumn Transit Map Mystery
story.question: Can the squirrel and mouse reorganize the scattered routing tags before the morning express arrives?
story.answer: Yes, by aligning the color codes with the morning seed supply weights.

story_beats.headline: The Missing Route Markers
story_beats.speech: Every single destination tag has fallen onto the pavement, creating a massive puzzle across the bustling city plaza.
story_beats.label: First Discovery
story_beats.visual_prompt: A brown squirrel stands confused in the bustling city street, staring at fallen paper tags on the concrete ground.

story_beats.headline: Gathering the Clues
story_beats.speech: We need to collect every misplaced direction card before the dawn commuters arrive to navigate the morning puzzle.
story_beats.label: Gathering Pieces
story_beats.visual_prompt: A gray mouse scurries across the city sidewalk, lifting a small colored paper card with its tiny paws.

story_beats.headline: The Weight Method
story_beats.speech: Instead of reading the faded symbols, let us test how heavy each marker feels against a single acorn.
story_beats.label: Testing Weight
story_beats.visual_prompt: A brown squirrel balances a metal token on a stone curb in the city square while holding a single acorn.

story_beats.headline: Transit Restored
story_beats.speech: The correct sequence is locked in place, allowing all the travelers to find their paths safely once more.
story_beats.label: Final Solution
story_beats.visual_prompt: A gray mouse taps the final aligned marker on a low stone wall within the city pedestrian zone.

story.central_conflict: Scattered transit markers blocking the morning distribution schedule in the city.
story.decisive_choice: Sorting the colored tags by weight rather than alphabetical order.
story.resolution: The morning transit system resumes normal operation without delay.
